items.title: Forklift Battery Protection Controller
items.summary: Industrial Lithium Battery Protection Controller (04/2026 - Present)
description: Designed a custom protection controller PCB for electric forklift lithium battery systems, using the ESP32 as the main MCU. The controller communicates with the BMS over CAN Bus and RS485 to monitor voltage, current, SOC, SOH, temperature, and active alarm status in real time.

When battery conditions fall below configured thresholds, the system drives relays to disable fork lifting and lowering while still allowing the vehicle to return to the charging station safely. A local SPI display, EEPROM-based history logging, and a web configuration interface support threshold tuning, fault tracing, and reliable operation in EMI/EMC-sensitive industrial environments.

items.title: Lithium Battery Management System - BMS
items.summary: Lithium Battery Protection and Monitoring System (12/2025 - Present)
description: Designed schematics and 2-layer PCB layouts for lithium battery management systems, covering high-current power paths, ADC measurement circuits, protection stages, noise suppression, and ESD protection for reliable battery protection and status monitoring.

Developed the embedded firmware independently on STM32 using HAL and FreeRTOS, implementing ADC data acquisition, digital signal filtering, protection logic, and peripheral control. Integrated CAN Bus, RS485, I2C, UART, and SPI to support lithium battery protection and real-time monitoring applications.

items.title: CAN Bus Gateway Controller
items.summary: Embedded Hardware & Firmware Engineer — BMS & Charger Protocol Converter
description: Designed and developed a complete CAN Bus gateway controller system from hardware to firmware and field deployment. The system converts and synchronizes communication between Battery Management System (BMS) and charger devices using different CAN protocols, enabling seamless interoperability in industrial battery systems.

I handled the full engineering cycle: schematic design, PCB layout, embedded firmware development on STM32, CAN frame parsing and filtering, UART debug logging, EEPROM configuration storage, enclosure assembly, wiring, and real-world validation with CAN Analyzer, oscilloscope, and actual BMS/charger hardware.

fallbackImages.alt: Smart Industrial Valve Controller 4-layer PCB render

items.title: Smart Industrial Valve Controller
description: Designed schematics and 4-layer PCB layouts for an industrial valve controller with AGND/DGND separation, EMI/EMC-conscious routing, ESD protection, and robust 4-20 mA / 0-10 V interfaces for noise-tolerant operation in factory environments. I also designed the H-Bridge motor driver stage for precise stepper motor actuation, covering direction control, current handling, and protection circuitry for reliable field operation.

Developed the embedded firmware on STM32 using HAL and FreeRTOS, implementing PID control, encoder feedback, Kalman filtering, ADC processing, EEPROM wear-leveling, self-diagnostics, and industrial communications over RS485 Modbus RTU, SPI, I2C, and UART with CRC checking. I supported end-to-end testing and deployment at TS FOOD factory, including HMI/PLC configuration, valve calibration, motor tuning, and operational acceptance testing, while continuing to develop V2 with enhanced monitoring and control capabilities.

items.title: Vehicle Navigation Display
items.summary: Low-Power Vehicle Navigation Display with QSPI High-Brightness Screen
description: This project is a compact navigation display system designed for vehicle applications. I designed a custom 4-layer PCB based on EMI/EMC design practices, focusing on signal integrity, stable power distribution, noise reduction, and reliable operation in mobile environments.

The system uses an nRF52840 microcontroller and a high-resolution QSPI display with high brightness for clear visibility. The design focuses on low-power operation, battery optimization, fast display refresh, and expandability for additional features such as wireless connectivity, sensor integration, interface customization, and real-time navigation information display.

items.title: Application of LoRa Mesh Network in Environmental Monitoring
items.summary: Graduation Thesis | Embedded Hardware & Firmware Engineer (01/2024 - 05/2024)
description: Designed the schematics and PCB layout for an ESP32-based central control board, integrating power supply stages, sensor modules, and low-power communication hardware for a distributed environmental monitoring system.

Developed firmware to acquire multi-sensor data over ADC, UART, I2C, and SPI, implemented and optimized a LoRa Mesh routing algorithm for stable long-range communication, and synchronized real-time data to Firebase with a mobile application for visualization and threshold-based alerts. The thesis achieved a final score of 9.17/10 (Grade A).
